About Us

About Sankalp Precast

Sankalp Precast is a manufacturer and supplier of Modular RCC Compound Walls, providing practical boundary wall solutions for residential, industrial, agricultural, commercial and institutional properties.

Our precast RCC wall system is designed to provide a strong, durable and efficient alternative to conventional boundary wall construction. With precision factory casting, steel rebar reinforcement, and swift on-site modular erection, we eliminate construction hassles and deliver unmatched boundary security.

Our Mission

To provide reliable, durable and cost-effective RCC boundary wall solutions with quality manufacturing and professional installation.

Our Vision

To become a trusted name in the precast RCC boundary wall industry through quality products, dependable service and customer satisfaction.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Modular RCC Compound Wall?

A modular RCC compound wall is a precast concrete boundary wall system made using RCC panels and supporting posts manufactured in a controlled factory environment.

How long does installation take?

Installation time depends on the total boundary length, site conditions and project requirements. Typically, our crew can install 100 to 250 running feet per day, which is up to 5x faster than brick masonry.

Where can RCC compound walls be used?

They can be used for residential, industrial, agricultural, commercial, institutional and construction properties.

Do you provide installation?

Yes. Sankalp Precast can provide supply and professional installation services from start to finish.

Are RCC compound walls low maintenance?

Precast RCC walls generally require relatively low routine maintenance compared with many conventional boundary wall systems. They do not need recurring plastering or structural maintenance.

Can I get a quotation for my property?

Yes. Contact our team with your approximate boundary length and location to discuss your project requirements.
